programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
programme.desc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
programme.desc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
programme.desc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #3
programme.desc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #4
programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #5
programme.desc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: 安(希芙嘉咸飾)是一位瑜伽導師,儘管她的家人讓她抓狂,約會生活又悲慘,但她仍努力實現內心的平靜。

programme.title: 傑克泰勒: 煉獄之中
programme.desc: 傑克和達華受僱於一家大型軟件公司的老闆,查出是誰竊取了他們寶貴的遊戲數據。

programme.title: 永不屈服
programme.desc: 一名英國護士安妮在她的哨站遭到猛烈襲擊後,她與一小群士兵一起逃亡。她必須在勇敢與同情之間取得平衡,以拯救一個土著女孩、她的丈夫和她的殖民地。

programme.title: 鐵血鑽石
programme.desc: 價值5000萬的非法鑽石被盜,一名前綜合格鬥家和他的兄弟們必須從一個危險的犯罪集團手中解救他們被綁架的家人。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #4
programme.desc: 宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓來到尾聲。對於來自角川學園,因排球資歷尚淺而跟不上練習進度的百澤,日向告訴他一件事。此時參加全國青年強化集訓的影山和全日本的佼佼者共同打球時有了新發現。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #5
programme.desc: 一行人再次迎來與白鳥澤3年級生的練習賽。而影山於青年強化集訓在換過場上位置的狀態下進行練習賽。宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓、全日本青年強化集訓終於迎來最後一天。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #1
programme.desc: 深澄真和識朝著學園中央都市,遇到了人類少女拉娜和獸人少年艾德。他們尋求幫助,以對抗威脅他們村莊的盜賊。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #2
programme.desc: 才華洋溢的女高中生音無響被召喚為勇者,去對抗魔族,而另一位勇者岩橋智樹則出現在古里多尼亞帝國。

programme.title: 海賊王 #490
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #6

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #4
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #5
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞成功地在魔法學院以強烈鮮明的反派千金形象登場,在校內順利地招來各種厭惡。就在此時,國王發來了茶會的邀請函。主要人物全員齊聚的場面令艾莉西亞靈光一現,「這一定就是『惡役千金考驗』了吧!」

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #15
programme.desc: 「去造訪能驅魔的古代眷屬」。乙木家收到了妮可的母親伊吹的新預言。妮可等人決定先去找那些人談談。一方面也因為那裡和乙木家的距離沒有很遠,所以妮可、守仁、監志、圭護以及音夢這五人抱著「暑假出門玩」的心態前往古代眷屬所在的地點。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼霧生見晴成為乙木家的新房客。夜貓子的他才剛搬進來就開始睡到下午才起來的悠哉生活。他除了一般的食物外還需要額外吸取精氣,每次才剛起床就會跑來向守仁要精氣。在擺明就不適合團體生活的見晴的加入下,乙木家前途多難的生活又將進一步全面升級?

programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #5
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞成功地在魔法學院以強烈鮮明的反派千金形象登場,在校內順利地招來各種厭惡。就在此時,國王發來了茶會的邀請函。主要人物全員齊聚的場面令艾莉西亞靈光一現,「這一定就是『惡役千金考驗』了吧!」

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #15
programme.desc: 「去造訪能驅魔的古代眷屬」。乙木家收到了妮可的母親伊吹的新預言。妮可等人決定先去找那些人談談。一方面也因為那裡和乙木家的距離沒有很遠,所以妮可、守仁、監志、圭護以及音夢這五人抱著「暑假出門玩」的心態前往古代眷屬所在的地點。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #16
programme.desc: 吸血鬼霧生見晴成為乙木家的新房客。夜貓子的他才剛搬進來就開始睡到下午才起來的悠哉生活。他除了一般的食物外還需要額外吸取精氣,每次才剛起床就會跑來向守仁要精氣。在擺明就不適合團體生活的見晴的加入下,乙木家前途多難的生活又將進一步全面升級?

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #5

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅
programme.desc: 希伯來書除了論證耶穌基督的超越性之外,字裡行間隨時都有對猶太信徒的勸勉,因為這些猶太信徒受本族人的壓力,產生許多疑難,信心開始動搖。藉着希伯來書,蘇穎睿牧師帶你走進歷史,閱覽這趟考驗信心之旅。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 今日説法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#72粵
programme.desc: 義及情被停職。義帶情到對手「日進保險」公司理論，竟揭發安是該公司的太子爺！情失落閒蕩卻遇上連串好事，但一切皆是安的補償。情主動往找安，更說明早已原諒他，但請他澄清有關義的嫌疑，這時義及溢卻出現大鬧安。

programme.title: 尚食#12粵普
programme.desc: 莊妃殉葬，宮中眾人不免兔死狐悲。朱高熾登基為帝，有意還都南京，又更改先帝所定國策，太子瞻基規勸。胡尚食在太子妃面前揭開姚子衿的身世，想捏造罪名陷害子衿，被瞻基救下。在瞻基追問下，子衿道出她入宮的目的。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 龍脷葉有助清熱，鼎爺親自採摘這種草藥，煲出滋潤的「雪梨龍脷葉沙參湯」。雪梨要切走芯去除澀味，連皮食用還能更有益！厴仔蟹肉嫩殼薄，用來烹調「鹽焗蝦蟹煲」容易入味。天使蝦較薄身，鹽焗前宜用紗紙包好避免過鹹。炮製油器講究功夫，主持們細談箇中手藝。釀鯪魚的配搭多變，「鬼馬釀鯪魚」更有兩種吃法！鼎爺將鯪魚肉等材料釀入油條內，炸出香脆口感；另會用鯪魚骨、鯪魚頭煲湯，放入略為炸過的鯪魚油條同煮，又是另一番滋味！

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 美國新發佈一份飲食指南，可謂顛覆固有食物金字塔的理念，着重選吃原型食物、摒除加工食品；除此以外，還有甚麼改變？心臟科醫生指，重點是要分清哪些是「好碳水化合物」和「好蛋白質」。跑步可增強心肺功能，減低慢性疾病風險，也有人提到跑步傷膝，易致退化性關節炎。跑步傷膝的說法孰真孰假？物理治療師詳細解說，並強調運動量與姿勢較為重要，還會示範幾個有助強化關節的動作。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「韓風辣炒豬肉鮮魷」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍逗留汕頭這段日子，已習慣當地的飲食習慣，要夠新鮮！前往海島南澳，當然要在海邊即捕即煮，準備好「趕海」的工具，把生蠔、螺、帶子都夾起來，再放進高壓鍋烹調，隨即新鮮享用。島上亦有田園風味的農家菜席，並由老闆娘親自介紹多款小菜，包括窯雞、燜排骨、咸菜苦瓜、炒通菜等，一碗「生津藤雞湯」有何功效令祖藍要連湯帶渣喝掉？入夜後在地攤親自炒冰，祖藍試過後才知一杯炒冰也極花時間與力量，但自己炒的東西也特別美味！

programme.title: 五味人生#4粵
programme.desc: 勝天坐車入鎮時因肚瀉要求之科停車到草叢方便。永禎躲過追捕更乘機取去勝天留在車上的皮包……永禎被雙春等捉回向他追討騙款。勝天因汽車死火而獨個走到鎮上卻身無分文，竟搶了村童的砵仔糕充饑，又不慎看到正寬衣洗澡的金鳳，給痛毆後收押在牢房。永禎乘九妹睡著欲離開時卻中了他先前布下的「機關」……雙春要求永禎工作，當他送外賣到警署時，發現再次被捉回牢房的勝天，成功助勝天逃走帶往義莊匿藏；勝天感激，兩人更稱兄道弟。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 了原安排環的父親在節目最後醉酒鬧事，幸而一切早被百和千識穿，兩人將計就計讓IDOLiSH7在主會場唱歌。一織要求陸以後讓他控制，陸欣然答允。IDOLiSH7唱出TRIGGER的《SECRET NIGHT》，陸發揮其訴求力，現場觀眾反應熱烈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的動作有一定難度，大家宜按照自身能力，選擇做基本版還是進階版。先針對下肢肌力展開訓練，半蹲、站起循環做是基本動作，想增加難度可試試站立時踮腳尖。原地跳起也是常見練習，若雙腳跳起同時空中曲膝，連續做十二下又應付得來嗎？下一節鍛練主要圍繞核心肌群，做出平板支撐的姿勢，雙腳前後移動。躺下，用核心力量帶動雙腳抬起，並坐直身體，甚至站起來，教練卻發覺大家都有「作弊」？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 聖誕將至，美月因父母在海外工作，原本打算去祖父母的別墅度假，但聽說今年爸爸媽媽能回來，讓她興奮不已。接著，陽葵與美月便參加由學生會舉辦的聖誕派對，正當大家在雪地盡情玩耍，美月卻收到一個壞消息。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港是壓力城市，過去有調查顯示，大部分的受訪者覺得自有壓力，主要壓力來源是來自工作，至於減壓方法最多人會選擇做運動、購物、睡覺和看電視，亦有人會完全不理會自己的壓力問題。新聞掏寶和大家重溫2002年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2782粵
programme.desc: 樹根的衣服不慎跌進陳生居所，被陳生兄妹弄污。兩人事後仍若無其事地前往熊家借用豉油，樹仁憤而趕走他們，樹根卻反指樹仁不對。眾人奇怪樹根何以甘願借豉油給陳師奶，甚至她不在時仍對陳生兄妹百般容忍，遂設法逼他吐露真相。樹根終於揭開豉油的秘密，箇中涉及陳師奶年輕時與豉油廠少東一段不為人知的戀情，兩人慘遭拆散鴛鴦，陳師奶對少東所贈的豉油珍而重之，詎料……眾人擔心陳家的「豉油債、債不完」，尚善遂提出解決方法……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#9粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知繼續審理「秋月樓縱火案」，向來果斷的她卻一反常態，拖延判刑日期……此案告一段落，只有光正看穿惠知的用意。「兒童之家偽造文書案」續審，邵文依法判決，但他並非如表面般冷酷無情；雅晴意外得知後，對邵文改觀。光正被少女梁安娜潑一身紅油，源於她的母親因醫療事故離世，但涉事醫生獲律政司撤控。惠知與光正合作調查，揭發背後牽涉更多利益關係……天雪因生母的冷漠背棄而心靈受創，本想求助惠知，二人卻失諸交臂……

programme.title: 大生意人#4粵普
programme.desc: 為救常四，平原做了王天貴當舖泰裕豐的四掌櫃，卻遭排擠。一大漢來典當，平原成功化解難題，三個老朝奉便以請辭威脅來趕走他。於是平原找李欽合作，幫他的萬源當打響名號，百姓紛紛去泰裕豐贖回物品轉到萬源當典當。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 四川人愛吃麻辣菜式，家鋌師傅了解當地名菜棒棒雞後，決定用三黃雞與竹絲雞炮製「口水鴛鴦雞卷」，同樣香辣惹味！將兩種雞肉捲成卷狀，一口即可品嚐不同層次口感。透過片段，祖儀發現北方人偏愛以公雞入饌，師傅為她解釋中國南北方吃雞習慣的差異。西安大廚展身手，重現源自唐朝的佳餚；小儀師傅則以鹹魚這非遺食材煮芥蘭。過程中，她提到廚房術語之餘，還分享入廚知識。要令焯菜更翠綠，除了加糖外，下鍋時機亦十分關鍵。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#2粵PG
programme.desc: 一超市開幕，老闆楊孝文邀藝人剪綵引起混亂，楊光與同僚暴龍經過，成功控制場面；楊光遇叔父而被揭穿是該集團太子爺身份，暴龍愕然。文靜幫國富求情向國棟借錢還賭債，國富感激。國棟、文靜、簡潔及家聰相約郊遊，國棟大談與文靜的生育計劃，惟文靜還未有此打算。簡潔邀文靜到畫室工作卻遭國棟拒絕。楊光非有志做談判專家，但不想拒絕簡潔好意，只好參加面試。期間楊光遇同一警署工作的葉可人，楊光表現鎮定，可人卻因緊張而失準。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 中環某公廁清潔員被指用地拖抹地後，竟直接清潔鏡面與抹面盆，做法極不衛生！涉事清潔員初時否認事件，看片後態度可有變化？中年婦控訴內地丈夫多次不忠，質疑對方為取得香港身份證而騙婚。中年婦曾因心軟，原諒丈夫的過失，未料對方獲單程證後死性不改，深入追查下揭破丈夫召妓兼包養小三，更直闖其金屋藏嬌之地……新節目《試真D》、《退休有乜計》即將播映，送上相關宣傳活動花絮。濕重容易引致身體疲倦、水腫，有何去濕方法？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 美國新發佈一份飲食指南，可謂顛覆固有食物金字塔的理念，着重選吃原型食物、摒除加工食品；除此以外，還有甚麼改變？心臟科醫生指，重點是要分清哪些是「好碳水化合物」和「好蛋白質」。跑步可增強心肺功能，減低慢性疾病風險，也有人提到跑步傷膝，易致退化性關節炎。跑步傷膝的說法孰真孰假？物理治療師詳細解說，並強調運動量與姿勢較為重要，還會示範幾個有助強化關節的動作。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「韓風辣炒豬肉鮮魷」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍逗留汕頭這段日子，已習慣當地的飲食習慣，要夠新鮮！前往海島南澳，當然要在海邊即捕即煮，準備好「趕海」的工具，把生蠔、螺、帶子都夾起來，再放進高壓鍋烹調，隨即新鮮享用。島上亦有田園風味的農家菜席，並由老闆娘親自介紹多款小菜，包括窯雞、燜排骨、咸菜苦瓜、炒通菜等，一碗「生津藤雞湯」有何功效令祖藍要連湯帶渣喝掉？入夜後在地攤親自炒冰，祖藍試過後才知一杯炒冰也極花時間與力量，但自己炒的東西也特別美味！

programme.title: 五味人生#4粵
programme.desc: 勝天坐車入鎮時因肚瀉要求之科停車到草叢方便。永禎躲過追捕更乘機取去勝天留在車上的皮包……永禎被雙春等捉回向他追討騙款。勝天因汽車死火而獨個走到鎮上卻身無分文，竟搶了村童的砵仔糕充饑，又不慎看到正寬衣洗澡的金鳳，給痛毆後收押在牢房。永禎乘九妹睡著欲離開時卻中了他先前布下的「機關」……雙春要求永禎工作，當他送外賣到警署時，發現再次被捉回牢房的勝天，成功助勝天逃走帶往義莊匿藏；勝天感激，兩人更稱兄道弟。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#72粵
programme.desc: 義及情被停職。義帶情到對手「日進保險」公司理論，竟揭發安是該公司的太子爺！情失落閒蕩卻遇上連串好事，但一切皆是安的補償。情主動往找安，更說明早已原諒他，但請他澄清有關義的嫌疑，這時義及溢卻出現大鬧安。

programme.title: 尚食#12粵普
programme.desc: 莊妃殉葬，宮中眾人不免兔死狐悲。朱高熾登基為帝，有意還都南京，又更改先帝所定國策，太子瞻基規勸。胡尚食在太子妃面前揭開姚子衿的身世，想捏造罪名陷害子衿，被瞻基救下。在瞻基追問下，子衿道出她入宮的目的。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 在維多利亞島某餐廳，結帳前做甚麼可獲免費？為何清萊女士在等大象排便？Do姐向黎耀祥、江美儀發問，還給予大量提示，被美儀反過來指責！Do姐選擇沉默，卻令陸永與祥仔想通了答案，猜出台北拉麵店內用具的用途。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 森美、陳敏之在Do姐面前激鬥，爭奪享用官燕的機會！森美就像先知，對韓國吃炸雞文化瞭如指掌，相反敏之顯現無知的一面，C君又被指幫不上忙，勝負顯而易見！Do姐帶來一瓶孕婦爭相搶食的沙律醬，內有甚麼乾坤？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#73粵
programme.desc: 眾人與亨大嘆榴槤，但麗對榴槤極為反感，眾人竟勸麗嘗試，亨更迫麗吃下榴槤！麗整夜沒有歸家，原來與亨被困在升降機內。獲救後麗趕去淋浴，亨卻跑去銷毀閉路電視的錄影帶，此舉令人懷疑二人在升降機中發生了一夜情。

programme.title: 尚食#13粵普
programme.desc: 孟尚食重回尚食局，並向皇上告發井泉中飽私囊，王司膳替協助井泉的胡善圍頂罪，被遷出宮，月華大受打擊。皇后有恙卻被太醫院診出喜脈，唯盛寅有不同診斷，胡善圍命子衿幫月華負責皇后膳食，子衿瞧出端倪，提醒瞻基。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺帶來幾近失傳的「網油腰肝卷」，菜式採用新鮮豬網油包着豬腰、雞膶、金華火腿、臘腸等炸香，留意鼎爺清潔豬網油的步驟，以及片豬腰的刀法。鼎爺與阿譚品嚐過本地農場走地雞菜式，即採用本地鮮雞炮製「紙包雞」。如何揀選優質鮮雞？斬件入紙袋炸，比直接炸雞更濃味嫩滑！此外，還可將雞件拆絲製作「涼拌雞絲粉皮」，鼎爺特意加入少許雞皮提升香味。不妨參考鼎爺處理粉皮及調較醬汁的方法。菜式配襯顏色鮮艷的蔬菜絲，擺盤精緻。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫師提到慢性疲勞綜合症與中醫學的「虛勞」相似，在香港相當普遍。此症會令患者情緒低落，甚至影響日常生活。醫師細說虛勞的三種證型徵狀，並介紹相關的舒緩湯水以及穴位按壓之法。原來龜、蛇等爬蟲類寵物亦可能需要美容？爬蟲美容師攜同其飼養的爬蟲類寵物現身節目，細說為何在家飼養的烏龜、蜥蜴等有美容需要，並分享美容所需工具及注意事項。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範一道「自家肉丸油鹽水浸絲瓜」，清甜爽口。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 食海鮮，當然要食最新鮮，在海上大排檔開餐，一定夠鮮美！場內選擇甚多，祖藍遂讓老闆發辦，南澳才有的椰子螺，口感如何？老闆還告知南澳有三寶：紫菜、苦瓜、海瓜子，分別以甚麼形式讓祖藍吃得極為滿足？不得不提的還有最新鮮的地道海膽！卡丁車風馳電掣後，祖藍入夜在戶外嘗試親自以炭火烤肉，但這兒的食材特別大份，要上手不易。還是轉與當地話劇團代表愉快對談，加深認識潮汕的文化、傳統與精神；究竟潮汕人可會如想像般保守？

programme.title: 五味人生#5粵
programme.desc: 永禎帶勝天與鎮長等人到酒樓，勝天更證明永禎替任家辦事。勝天向鎮長提出要捉拿痛毆自己之人；九妹挺身而出，為報答連家而替潤月頂罪。雙春為救九妹求永禎幫忙，更簽下沒有欠款數目的欠單給他。在飛揚到達當天，受到盛大歡迎，更聽到鎮上的鄉親對勝天讚口不絕……飛揚私下與永禎傾談，提出要永禎盡快離開。照仁與照義拿出永禎賣給他們的欠單，要雙春把酒樓交給他們；飛揚與若嵐相遇，更發現她就是自己的師妹。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 《Friends Day》結束後，IDOLiSH7和TRIGGER人氣急增，惟Re:vale和ZOOL先後退出MOP，令排名三四的I7和TRIGGER處境尷尬，更惹來做假賽疑雲。了計劃在MOP後揭穿天和陸是雙胞胎，透真於心不忍，偷偷跑去通知百，詎料卻被了發現。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 本集「Artspiration」由繪畫導師教畫松鼠。為令圖畫更像真，她建議選用咖啡色顏色筆，並加上粉紅面珠增添可愛感，再為松鼠繪上最愛的松果，作品更生動。「開心SHARE」環節中，大家分享「我最喜愛的地區」。有小朋友公開於大嶼山出海觀賞中華白海豚的片段，並從中啟發支持環保的想法。也有女生分享在沙田生活的快樂點滴，還提及於區內博物館中認識到功夫巨星李小龍的事蹟，引起主持姐姐的興趣，計劃一同前往參觀。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 為了增強校內的偶像公主風氣，維多利亞校長決定成立偶像公主學會。學會的會長將由投票選出，在自薦與舉薦下，候選人有千依、愛里、琳琳、美月與陽葵五人。然而，陽葵仍是缺乏信心，還向阿櫻提出棄權……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 屯門一個兩房單位，戶主夫婦及3隻寵物，均要獨立空間，空間應讓如何劃分？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2783粵
programme.desc: 蘇姐偶遇細曹總並出手相助，讓細曹總留下好印象。蘇姐經相睇結識合意對象，卻發現對方存心騙財，還以雲南語侮辱她。蘇姐聽不明白，幸獲細曹總為她出頭。另一方面，力蓮與細曹總洽談合作，卻發現他的廣東話越發「難明」。碰巧鐵手出外公幹，力蓮遂找若水暫任秘書，要她翻譯細曹總的說話，若水只好設法破解「密碼」……其後，力蓮再與細曹總談生意，若水暗中翻譯，怎料生出變故，幸而此時遇到蘇姐，她竟能準確解讀細曹總的說話……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#10粵PG
programme.desc: 思義與兒子知行不睦，源於多年前一宗郊野雙屍案，思義懷疑知行有份參與。邵玲負責的感化少年吸毒過量身亡，令她挫敗欲辭職。惠知接手校園霸凌案，匿名影片顯示兩中學生用電卷棒燙傷鍾妙芝。惠知追查下竟發現天雪或牽涉欺凌……邵文獲推薦晉升區院，為討好升遷委員會主席方官，在其妹的傷人案暗中相助，結果卻出人意料。淑樺要脅惠知退出審訊，否則公開一段對天雪不利的片段，惠知陷於公義與親情兩難，重看片段卻發現似有隱情……

programme.title: 大生意人#5粵普
programme.desc: 老八家之一的康家因丟失軍隊輜重而拍賣家產，平原和紫軒競價，最後由平原拿下。此時申王帶兵來到，抓走老八家代表，要他們拿出銀兩自救，否則要向太平號打下欠條，平原細想後猜測這是連環計，其真正目的是闖王寶藏…

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 雲南的傣族人無酸不歡，常將摘得的野果、野菜放入容器內舂碎做火鍋，百味交雜。紫欣嘗試以在香港買到的水果，採同樣舂碎的大方向，做出一鍋港版「雲南野果火鍋」，為何要特別選用可連皮吃的水果？枇杷芒果又是甚麼東東？祖儀透過網購，為拍檔永權與世韜師傅帶來急凍鱘魚扒，原來魚的每個部位，皆有不同菜餚的建議做法。片段中見過遼寧本溪市的全魚宴，世韜師傅改用一條紅衫魚，奉上「陳皮炒紅衫魚球」與「番茄豆腐紅衫魚湯」兩食！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#3粵
programme.desc: 楊光首次勸服的自殺者齊家全，覺楊光關心自己，遂苦纏楊光。楊光避開，家全激動跳海，幸被楊光及時救起。國棟發現文靜食避孕丸，文靜終說出不想生育，國棟讓步暫押後生育計劃並讓文靜外出工作。臨床心理學家楊孝武，向談判小組人員講解測驗內容，他亦是楊光同父異母兄弟。楊光與可人參與模擬談判，楊光默不作聲讓可人盡量發揮，簡潔卻見楊光於可人耳邊提點意見，觀察力強。楊光與可人同被取錄。可人介紹家全到社區中心工作。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫師提到慢性疲勞綜合症與中醫學的「虛勞」相似，在香港相當普遍。此症會令患者情緒低落，甚至影響日常生活。醫師細說虛勞的三種證型徵狀，並介紹相關的舒緩湯水以及穴位按壓之法。原來龜、蛇等爬蟲類寵物亦可能需要美容？爬蟲美容師攜同其飼養的爬蟲類寵物現身節目，細說為何在家飼養的烏龜、蜥蜴等有美容需要，並分享美容所需工具及注意事項。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範一道「自家肉丸油鹽水浸絲瓜」，清甜爽口。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 食海鮮，當然要食最新鮮，在海上大排檔開餐，一定夠鮮美！場內選擇甚多，祖藍遂讓老闆發辦，南澳才有的椰子螺，口感如何？老闆還告知南澳有三寶：紫菜、苦瓜、海瓜子，分別以甚麼形式讓祖藍吃得極為滿足？不得不提的還有最新鮮的地道海膽！卡丁車風馳電掣後，祖藍入夜在戶外嘗試親自以炭火烤肉，但這兒的食材特別大份，要上手不易。還是轉與當地話劇團代表愉快對談，加深認識潮汕的文化、傳統與精神；究竟潮汕人可會如想像般保守？

programme.title: 五味人生#5粵
programme.desc: 永禎帶勝天與鎮長等人到酒樓，勝天更證明永禎替任家辦事。勝天向鎮長提出要捉拿痛毆自己之人；九妹挺身而出，為報答連家而替潤月頂罪。雙春為救九妹求永禎幫忙，更簽下沒有欠款數目的欠單給他。在飛揚到達當天，受到盛大歡迎，更聽到鎮上的鄉親對勝天讚口不絕……飛揚私下與永禎傾談，提出要永禎盡快離開。照仁與照義拿出永禎賣給他們的欠單，要雙春把酒樓交給他們；飛揚與若嵐相遇，更發現她就是自己的師妹。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#73粵
programme.desc: 眾人與亨大嘆榴槤，但麗對榴槤極為反感，眾人竟勸麗嘗試，亨更迫麗吃下榴槤！麗整夜沒有歸家，原來與亨被困在升降機內。獲救後麗趕去淋浴，亨卻跑去銷毀閉路電視的錄影帶，此舉令人懷疑二人在升降機中發生了一夜情。

programme.title: 尚食#13粵普
programme.desc: 孟尚食重回尚食局，並向皇上告發井泉中飽私囊，王司膳替協助井泉的胡善圍頂罪，被遷出宮，月華大受打擊。皇后有恙卻被太醫院診出喜脈，唯盛寅有不同診斷，胡善圍命子衿幫月華負責皇后膳食，子衿瞧出端倪，提醒瞻基。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 老字號繡莊開業近半世紀，見證無數美好姻緣。鎮店「褂皇」、「褂后」金碧輝煌，貴氣十足，挑選裙褂卻講究剪裁「夠鬆動」？中國象棋博大精深，當中不少精妙術語更是家傳戶曉，大學講師廖舜禧「擺明車馬」，大談跟象棋有關的俗語。書法藝術能能體現傳統中國文化，主持們斗膽挑戰書法家王羲之的「書聖」地位，可謂「陳顯南賣告白－ 得把口」！努力是邁向成功的不二法門，他們專誠拜訪青山寺參詳佛學，期間果然找到一道「不二法門」？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 粵劇演出需要大量籌備功夫，從穿著的戲服到臉上面譜均十分講究。歇後語「棚尾拉箱－ 暗中走人」，「箱」內收藏着豐富的戲曲文化。許多廣東俚語引用數字借代意思，箇中含意更可引經據典，絕非「亂噏廿四」！印刷技術不斷進步，活字印刷漸漸成為民間絕學。主持人拜訪印刷界老字號，實地了解昔日「執字粒」工藝。學好功夫為何要先吃「夜粥」？慈悲為懷的菩薩又何以被拿來咒罵別人？專家廖舜禧、鄭寶鴻分別解構。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 在超過九成人口都是穆斯林的伊斯蘭國家土耳其, 其引以為傲的藝術伊斯蘭書法, 及在水面展開的剎那間的藝術-埃布魯, 都跟伊斯蘭教息息相關 埃布魯的繪畫工具及靈感來源都源自大自然 在水中作畫, 把真主的旨意實踐出來

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 閨密團登上復古列車，展開鐵路遊。嘉賓馬貫東捧着飲品，為美女們帶來驚喜。四人先後享用特製早餐與懷舊便當，細談家庭、愛情觀。自小缺乏家庭溫暖的貫東，坦言最想變回嬰孩感受母愛。敏之深受觸動，為「囝囝」貫東送上窩心擁抱。說到演戲，貫東自覺性格內歛影響發展，又渴望接演大奸角；敏之亦分享拍攝親熱戲點滴。途經中途站Kinarut，眾人下車閒逛，並品嚐沙巴傳統糕點和水果。四小時車程結束後，他們又找到甚麼地道美食？

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: Ben Sir、祖儀、衍峰到布袋澳歎海鮮兼行山。蜆湯、墨魚刺身、蒸扇貝，鮮味留有餘溫。遷就Ben Sir，這次揀選相對易行路段，挑戰「三尖」之一的釣魚翁。走過陡峭山路，還要手腳並用，Ben Sir寶刀未老，成功登頂！鄧智堅領祖儀實試緣份精華遊，穿梭姻緣石與中環大館，上一課愛情速成班。祖儀、淑雅還有任務，與小朋友來趟宅度假，大玩帳幕露營、親子甜品班，放電最啱！菊梓喬應邀與穎彤決戰VR運動，齊齊爆汗！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主瀅仴提出討論南美洲文化，拍檔泳嘉、凱文隨即聯想到南美音樂。瀅仴指多元性是南美洲特色之一，從地理、人口、語言到宗教都能體現。談及南美的音樂與舞蹈，眾谷主首先想到森巴、探戈，瀅仴嘗試介紹相關舞種的起源與特色。她還播放了一段巴西戰舞的影片讓拍檔欣賞，原來這是一種融合舞蹈、武術、音樂、遊戲的藝術。谷主們亦推介南美景點好去處，並奉上旅遊攻略，其中包括被喻為「天空之鏡」的玻利維亞烏尤尼鹽沼，景色壯麗迷人。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐示範一道上海菜式，墨魚燜五花腩。用急凍墨魚或新鮮小墨魚也可以有同樣的效果；另外還加入冰糖燜煮和放一根指天椒，分別會增加光澤和令菜式提香，因為外省菜一般比較濃味，所以加調味料也要隨機應變。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組準備了幾段外語錄音，要小朋友單憑聲調語氣，猜想對方說話時的情感。日語的溫柔聲調，就令人誤以為必定是開心情緒，語言原來會影響觀感？提起印度人，小朋友會聯想到甚麼？永城帶港孩吳柏翹、何朗怡和來自南韓的金炫志到訪夏利里拉家族大宅，富麗堂皇的裝修陳設，印度小孩的帥氣打扮，都令訪客感到驚訝！小朋友們透過傳統的Hanna、瑜伽與康樂棋，體驗印度文化後，對印度人也有所改觀；柏翹更直言想結識更多印度朋友。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 田徑部部長拜託茜幫忙指導練習，後者無奈答應。E8候選駕駛員竟是伽馬，但伽馬拒絕加入。舞從副會長口中得知伽馬的過去，並已努力為同學爭取利益。伽馬聽過太晴的說話後，決定成為駕駛員。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」先帶來協調訓練，全身上下都運用得到，記得做好熱身！碎步跑的同時，要依照指定方向拍手。同手同腳抬起講求協調，加入跳躍動作難度升級；習慣後，就要轉交叉手腳。循環做雙腳打開、前後腳的跳步鍛練，教練還加快節奏，大家能否跟得上？接着的「伸展運動」同樣是全身練習，十指緊扣、反手舉高，朝不同方向做伸展。單手捉住腳踝，身體前傾，可順道考驗平衡力。做完手腳，也要轉動肩膊鬆一鬆。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 班上同學不約而同聲稱見到另一個小丸子，小丸子感到疑惑，終於在看牙醫時揭開真相，遇到長得酷似自己的石橋朋子。朋子邀請小丸子到家裡玩，卻令後者發現兩人除了外表相似，其他方面都天差地遠。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻：退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 洪天明成家立室後追求健康生活，也為家人減少危險工作。他笑言父親當上爺爺後更顯開朗，自己也會保持壯健體魄，盼退休後成為快樂爺爺。另一嘉賓蔣祖曼分享務農興趣，透露曾因拍戲連續五天未眠，但近年已開始注重健康。她希望為未來健康做好準備，退休時能自我照顧。眾主持亦走訪養生中心，了解先進的高科技養生設備；再往泰國華欣入住一站式療養度假村，並於曼谷享用星級養生宴。內地珠海近年興起智慧康養社區，詳情如何？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！歌手江若琳抽中自家作品，能否原聲重現？曾組男團出道、為繼續追夢而做電工師傅的崔可迪，也會接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 譚輝智 X 羅啟豪 下一站紅館粵
programme.desc: 譚輝智與羅啟豪獲鄭丹瑞(旦哥)賞識邀請，以二人雙聲形式踏上紅館開騷，旦哥為何從《中年好聲音》眾參賽者挑選他倆？啟豪、輝智在這集來一場預演，合作重新演繹張學友的<心碎了無痕，以及張天賦的<說謊者，揀歌有甚麼準則？他們亦分別演唱新歌<月球上的藍玫瑰和<娛初，前者藏有童話故事元素，後者的派台碟封面，引起可會是用輝智照片以AI改圖的討論！這兩首新作在「勁歌金榜」能否攀升？留意本星期金榜的排名倒數。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 雜碎原指食材邊角餘料，隨着烹調演化，逐漸「逆襲」成為餐桌上的主角。在菲律賓，不論深山或城市，當地民眾都不浪費豬隻任何部位，會剁碎製成地道食物希希格。四川人則將豬大腸煮成不同風味的肥腸，入口肥美甘香，是川渝人士忘不了的滋味。內蒙古草原上的牧羊民族，也善用羊隻的每個部位，水煮羊頭、烤羊肝都是自用美食。摩洛哥民眾亦愛吃羊，宰羊後還會用香料烹煮羊雜，與家人共享。另外，潮汕人偏愛滷鵝，最美味的部位是鵝頭？

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 跆拳道港將江麗莉登上女子品勢U40組別「世一」，她細談箇中賽制特色。賽車手區天駿為世界耐力錦標賽備戰，並分享成第二位香港車手征戰該賽事的心情。青少年棍網球公開賽，港隊於六個組別五摘錦標，這集焦點重溫男、女子U16精華。空手道女將劉慕裳出席交流會，向支持者傳授心得。五人制棒球亞洲盃召集九支隊伍爭逐，港隊表現如何？冰球IIB級別世錦賽，港隊以五戰全勝姿態封后，獲升班資格。另帶來學界室內賽艇比賽戰報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#15粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰在調查賈顥皚之際，也暗中調查晨；天齊在安老院發現賈顥皚對自己的妻子下手，賈顥皚追出並殺了天齊；晟杰等人設計引賈顥皚現身，賈顥皚藉機利用人質協助自己逃脫，眾人要在限時內救出人質和阻止賈顥皚逃掉…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: Ben Sir、祖儀、衍峰到布袋澳歎海鮮兼行山。蜆湯、墨魚刺身、蒸扇貝，鮮味留有餘溫。遷就Ben Sir，這次揀選相對易行路段，挑戰「三尖」之一的釣魚翁。走過陡峭山路，還要手腳並用，Ben Sir寶刀未老，成功登頂！鄧智堅領祖儀實試緣份精華遊，穿梭姻緣石與中環大館，上一課愛情速成班。祖儀、淑雅還有任務，與小朋友來趟宅度假，大玩帳幕露營、親子甜品班，放電最啱！菊梓喬應邀與穎彤決戰VR運動，齊齊爆汗！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主瀅仴提出討論南美洲文化，拍檔泳嘉、凱文隨即聯想到南美音樂。瀅仴指多元性是南美洲特色之一，從地理、人口、語言到宗教都能體現。談及南美的音樂與舞蹈，眾谷主首先想到森巴、探戈，瀅仴嘗試介紹相關舞種的起源與特色。她還播放了一段巴西戰舞的影片讓拍檔欣賞，原來這是一種融合舞蹈、武術、音樂、遊戲的藝術。谷主們亦推介南美景點好去處，並奉上旅遊攻略，其中包括被喻為「天空之鏡」的玻利維亞烏尤尼鹽沼，景色壯麗迷人。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 閨密團登上復古列車，展開鐵路遊。嘉賓馬貫東捧着飲品，為美女們帶來驚喜。四人先後享用特製早餐與懷舊便當，細談家庭、愛情觀。自小缺乏家庭溫暖的貫東，坦言最想變回嬰孩感受母愛。敏之深受觸動，為「囝囝」貫東送上窩心擁抱。說到演戲，貫東自覺性格內歛影響發展，又渴望接演大奸角；敏之亦分享拍攝親熱戲點滴。途經中途站Kinarut，眾人下車閒逛，並品嚐沙巴傳統糕點和水果。四小時車程結束後，他們又找到甚麼地道美食？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組讓孩子們試吃不同地方的早餐，俄羅斯小朋友竟對鹹豆漿、粢飯甚為喜歡？永城帶兩位港孩到訪韓國小朋友家中，體驗彼邦的家庭文化。「韓式飯卷」是當地代表食物，韓裔媽媽引領大家DIY，各人亦會一嚐自己的成品。「擲柶戲」是可多人參與的韓國傳統遊戲，如何進行？嬉戲過後，港、韓孩子還會隨導師學習K-pop舞蹈。兩位港孩趁着「你我」課題，探訪三個不同國家小朋友的家居，眾人直率地不分種族，融洽打成一片，教人欣喜。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 在超過九成人口都是穆斯林的伊斯蘭國家土耳其, 其引以為傲的藝術伊斯蘭書法, 及在水面展開的剎那間的藝術-埃布魯, 都跟伊斯蘭教息息相關 埃布魯的繪畫工具及靈感來源都源自大自然 在水中作畫, 把真主的旨意實踐出來

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 酷奇銀河遊騎隊
programme.desc: 聰明倉鼠吉克、勇敢松鼠露比、大力狗狗阿力，還有疾速貓咪閃電，組成了宇宙最酷的超級英雄組合！他們幫助其他星球的居民解決問題，保護銀河系，並對抗邪惡又神秘的鐵鷹怪！

programme.title: 酷奇銀河遊騎隊
programme.desc: 聰明倉鼠吉克、勇敢松鼠露比、大力狗狗阿力，還有疾速貓咪閃電，組成了宇宙最酷的超級英雄組合！他們幫助其他星球的居民解決問題，保護銀河系，並對抗邪惡又神秘的鐵鷹怪！

programme.title: 魔法小廚師
programme.desc: 魔法小廚師小令、茲普、史黛拉和陽陽，利用特魯莉奶奶的魔法食譜，享受烹飪、盡情冒險，每個食譜都充滿驚喜、風味和色彩，但大鬍子庫伯卻想偷走這本食譜！

programme.title: 豬豬俠大電影－海洋日記
programme.desc: 超星特務豬豬俠在上次的任務中留下了後遺症，但他堅持獨自潛入海底世界執行新任務。豬豬俠在五彩繽紛的海底世界看到各式各樣的海底生物，認識了正在尋找哥哥的小豆芽，被他勇敢、執著的精神感動，決定幫他一起尋找哥哥。原來海洋世界發生了一件不為人知的大事，導致大量海洋居民陸續失蹤……

programme.title: 耶！百變怪怪
programme.desc: 綠粉藍三兄妹想像力豐富又愛尋求刺激，能靠著幻想變化成任何東西，巨大的藍色狒狒、條紋綠氣球、一棵樹等等魔幻世界。透過好奇心滿滿的三兄妹，學會生活小故事。

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 魔法小廚師
programme.desc: 魔法小廚師小令、茲普、史黛拉和陽陽，利用特魯莉奶奶的魔法食譜，享受烹飪、盡情冒險，每個食譜都充滿驚喜、風味和色彩，但大鬍子庫伯卻想偷走這本食譜！

programme.title: 豬豬俠大電影－海洋日記
programme.desc: 超星特務豬豬俠在上次的任務中留下了後遺症，但他堅持獨自潛入海底世界執行新任務。豬豬俠在五彩繽紛的海底世界看到各式各樣的海底生物，認識了正在尋找哥哥的小豆芽，被他勇敢、執著的精神感動，決定幫他一起尋找哥哥。原來海洋世界發生了一件不為人知的大事，導致大量海洋居民陸續失蹤……

programme.title: 耶！百變怪怪
programme.desc: 綠粉藍三兄妹想像力豐富又愛尋求刺激，能靠著幻想變化成任何東西，巨大的藍色狒狒、條紋綠氣球、一棵樹等等魔幻世界。透過好奇心滿滿的三兄妹，學會生活小故事。

programme.title: 酷奇銀河遊騎隊
programme.desc: 聰明倉鼠吉克、勇敢松鼠露比、大力狗狗阿力，還有疾速貓咪閃電，組成了宇宙最酷的超級英雄組合！他們幫助其他星球的居民解決問題，保護銀河系，並對抗邪惡又神秘的鐵鷹怪！

programme.title: 紳士與小姐(完)
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗吃、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃(完)
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini’s hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she’s been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Arcadian Job
programme.desc: When Aja and Krel learn a secret, military base may house an alien spacecraft, they enlist Stuart to help them infilitrate it. Meanwhile, General Morando unviels his latest weapon - Omen, a deadly, cyborg assassin.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex - and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Bumperdome Broaches
programme.desc: A near-accident gives Chet his first adrenaline rush, and in his quest for another he enters a dangerous race inside a pinball machine. The FAST team must work together to keep a group of sewer surfing roaches from entering the taco stand so that Tito can pass his health inspection.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - African Queen Mega Snails
programme.desc: The FAST crew is tricked into going to Africa by the Queen of the Banana Slugs for a dangerous journey through the plains in order to save her tribe. White Shadow is challenged by three over-zealous and over-sized championship sumo wrestler snails to an outrageous wrestling match.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Best in Show Bot The Secret of Madame Baroness
programme.desc: Archibald hides inside Loy's robot after accidentally breaking it. A lost boomerang leads to a job working for a fancy singer.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Sleepy Toys
programme.desc: Everyone in Brickabuild keeps falling asleep and no one can get any building work finished. It's all because the lights keep coming on all night! Noddy decides to investigate who is turning the lights on. Bravely overcoming his own fear of the dark, he follows the clues to discover that the lights are being secretly turned on by a scared Carlton, who doesn't like the dark.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Secret Deliveries
programme.desc: Someone is giving presents to everyone in Toyland and all the toys want to say thank you but no one knows the identity of the secret gift giver! It's up to Noddy to investigate and find out who is it that's leaving presents for all the friends. By following clues and using his investigation skills, Noddy follows the trail to Animal Acres and discovers that Pat Pat and the Pockets are the secret gift-givers.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Little Lost Toy
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is delighted because a little clockwork duck has appeared at the DinoLab. No one knows where she belongs but Noddy is sure that her family must be missing her so he decides to investigate and find her home. Noddy uses all his skills of thinking, looking, listening and asking questions to find the home for the little duck.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of Jumpy Revs
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in Toyland. Lots of things seem to be jumping in a particular direction for no reason - Revs, Noddy's bell, Big Ear's spoons and kettle. What is going on? Noddy decides to investigate and help his best friend Revs who is very upset.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Flamingo Stands On One Leg
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Flamingo stood on both legs. One morning, Flamingo and her flock landed at the Water Hole when all the crabs were busy performing their underwater dance. Needless to say, all these legs where in their way! Tortoise came up with the plan that if all Crabs each nipped a flamingo leg, there will be room to share the waterhole. So from then on, Flamingo stood on one legs and Crabs were able to perform their dance in the watering hole

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Woodpecker Pecks
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Woodpecker didn't peck. All the birds had their very own sound, but Woodpecker didn't make a sound at all.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Zooming Zipwire
programme.desc: Ted and PC Selby are building a zipwire to run from Greendale Crag all the way down into the valley. The kids are on a hike, led by Lauren which is due to culminate at the zipwire - the only trouble is, it's not built yet! Pat and Jess have to race against time to deliver the huge steel cable to the top of the crag before the kids get there.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Super Jet Boots
programme.desc: Julian and the kids at Greendale School are excited about a Festival of flight - Ted's coming to talk about aviation and Alf's bringing Cedric the racing pigeon. Pat has to deliver special jet boots to the school, built by Ted's inventor friend. Ted will demonstrate them. But on the way to Greendale, Pat stops to help Alf, whose cows have got loose. Pat sees Ajay, out for a day's bird-watching.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Baritone Tea Part 1 Baritone Tea Part 2
programme.desc: Uh, oh - Archibald accidentally drinks all of Finly's vocal-enhancing tea on the eve of his brother's big concert!

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Deja Flu Crackridge Live
programme.desc: It's Archibald to the rescue when Loy, Sage and Finly come down with a bad case of the Déjà Flu. Archibald and Cousin Ashley take over the airwaves.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Unhelpful Queen
programme.desc: One of the Knights has tried a magic spell but it went wrong and he's shrunk! Queen Sparklewings could help him but she's hiding and won't come out. It's up to Noddy to investigate and work out why the Queen is hiding and how to persuade her to help the Knight grow again.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Mystery Artist
programme.desc: There's a mystery in Toyland! All the toys have drawn pictures of Deltoid but they've all been scribbled on and ruined! Noddy opens the investigation to find out who is the mystery artist. Using his wwwbook to follow the clues, Noddy realises that it's Deltoid who was drawing on all the pictures because he didn't think any of them look like him! Noddy suggests that they draw pictures again - and this time Deltoid can draw his own picture too. Clever Noddy's saved the day!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of Bling's Hidden Present
programme.desc: It's Bling's birthday and she is so excited that she keeps opening all her presents before her party. Noddy needs to make sure she doesn't open the storybook present from him and Big Ears early - but he's got to find it first! Big Ears has hidden it and can't remember where he's put it! Noddy launches his investigation to find the missing present before Bling does. Using his investigating skills Noddy follows the clues all over Toyland to find the present before the impatient little Naughticorn.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Big Wall Of Bricks
programme.desc: Fuse has a new electronic ball. Noddy suggests that they invite everyone to play with it later. Fuse agrees but when Noddy returns with the other toys there is a big brick wall in front of the workshop. No one can get in and there's no sign of Fuse! Noddy uses all his investigating skills to follow the clues. He discovers that Fuse built the brick wall to stop his friends coming into the workshop because he was worried his new electronic ball might get broken.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Detectives
programme.desc: There's a mystery in the dollhouse! When things start to mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy play detectives, using all their senses to find clues, follow them, and solve the mystery. For our COTD segment, CatRat and Baby Me-Owls show us how to make ice cube paints!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Home Alone
programme.desc: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Slobber Power
programme.desc: Cutter gets a chance to be a "mom" when a newly hatched dragon bonds with him, and they'll both be needed to get the others out of a tangled mess.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.
